purpose: A bar missing its high and a bar with a non-positive price make the input invalid; the detector rejects the bar-set and produces no geometry (INVALID_INPUT / INVALID_PRICE).

expected_second_anchor.reason: Input is invalid (missing high at t=3; non-positive low at t=5), so geometry is not run.

rejection_rationale.candidate: Fitting geometry after imputing/interpolating the missing t=3 high
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Per §1 a bar missing high or close is invalid input; no synthetic gap-filling or imputation is allowed.
rejection_rationale.numeric: H[3] is empty -> ln(H[3]) undefined -> INVALID_INPUT at t=3 (reject bar-set).

rejection_rationale.candidate: Accepting the t=5 bar with a zero low
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: All prices must be > 0 for ln to be defined (§1, §3); a non-positive price is INVALID_PRICE.
rejection_rationale.numeric: L[5]=0.00 <= 0 -> ln undefined -> INVALID_PRICE at t=5 (reject bar-set).

key_inequalities: t=3 high is missing -> ln(H) undefined -> INVALID_INPUT.
Positivity and completeness are preconditions to geometry; the bar-set is rejected, no line produced.
geometry_check.notes: Locks the §1/§18 input-validation preconditions: missing required fields and non-positive prices are named, deterministic rejections, not silent passes.
